components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Lets an Original with the werewolf gene become an Original hybrid, or frees a bound hybrid so that it can shift again.
The target stands on the centre (the caster if nobody does); a villager and a wolf must stand in the circle: they are the sacrifice, and they are killed.
Anyone else is refused: the caster is told only that the rite would change nothing, and the ingredients come back.
Needs a full moon: the moon must be full, between dusk and dawn, in the Overworld. An eclipse counts too. The hub's moon calendar shows when the next one rises.

Moonstone: craft it from an amethyst shard and a silver ingot (from Werewolves), in any order.

This rite needs the Werewolves mod.
